headline: US SEC and Japan FSA Hold Autumn Financial Regulatory Dialogue in Tokyo
summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and Japan's Financial Services Agency convened their Autumn Financial Regulatory Dialogue in Tokyo.
why: Bilateral regulatory dialogues between major economic superpowers align cross-border securities oversight, compliance standards, and enforcement cooperation.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Regulatory cooperation between US and Japanese financial authorities strengthens cross-border market surveillance and compliance frameworks.
